<system>
<task>
The conversation above has grown long. Produce a compaction summary that will REPLACE everything above as the ResearchManager's starting context for future turns. Anything not captured here is lost, so: references must be exact and verbatim; everything else must be brief.
</task>
<instructions>
Output exactly one block in this format and nothing else:
<compaction_summary>
    <conversation_digest>The user's goals, the questions asked so far (one line each), and any standing constraints or preferences.</conversation_digest>
    <task_digests>One line per completed task: objective, specialist, outcome with key numbers.</task_digests>
    <deliverables_ledger>Copy VERBATIM every deliverable reference from the handoffs and reports above: absolute file paths with schema and row counts, figure download links (prefer https URLs over sandbox paths), table names, entity ids. Never paraphrase, never drop an entry.</deliverables_ledger>
    <open_threads>Unresolved questions or pending follow-ups; write "none" if empty.</open_threads>
</compaction_summary>
</instructions>
</system>
